hamburg-schlei-fjord-and-angeln-loop.title: Hamburg · Schlei Fjord and Angeln Loop
hamburg-schlei-fjord-and-angeln-loop.slogan: A 323 km loop out of Neumünster fuel escape
hamburg-schlei-fjord-and-angeln-loop.story: Baltic fjord light, small ferries and polished touring pace. A 323 km loop that starts and ends near Neumünster, about 5 h 35 of riding. On the way it passes Schleswig harbour sight, Geltinger Birk coast edge and Kappeln Schlei bridge. It keeps to quiet secondary roads.
